0022600158.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (4-2, 3-0 at home, 1-2 on the road, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Cleveland Cavaliers (4-2, 3-0 at home, 1-2 on the road, on a one-game winning streak) in the Thunder's seventh game of the season. Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), while Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson is day-to-day with hamstring soreness and is a game-time decision. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, the Thunder won the 2025-26 series 2-0, and their last meeting was a 121-113 Oklahoma City win on February 22, 2026.
